prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Split Overview Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate step into a split layout presenting pet traits alongside official adoption details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Review & Confirm Pet Adoption Details", "body": "Verify your pet's attributes and name before finalizing adoption."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Sign-In Order: Move sign-in to take place right before final home setup instead of before selecting and customizing a pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Start Screen: Add a dedicated summary screen before finish detailing desktop tray shortcuts and pet interaction commands.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_summary", "home_intro"], "new_controls_summary": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Controls", "body": "Learn how to summon, minimize, and talk to your pet on your desktop.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Got It!"}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Style Selection Flow: Insert a style picker screen during custom pet adoption so users can select rendering styles before generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_style_picker", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_style_picker": {"headline": "Select Pet Rendering Style", "body": "Choose how your custom pet renders on your desktop.", "layout": "grid"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Renderer Launch Time Info: Enable time estimates and explicit progress indicators on the waiting screen during desktop pet loading.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Initializing Desktop Pet Renderer", "body": "Setting up graphics assets and desktop integration..."}}
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Scroll Showcase Layout: Switch the introductory story screen layout to story_scroll to highlight key pet behaviors upfront.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Discover how your pet lives, plays, and assists right on your desktop screen."}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Pet Profile Sync Notice: Display a explicit reassurance hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in preserves existing pet data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your pet settings and profile stay saved across desktop restarts."}}
7: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Choice Copy: Update headline and body on choose_path to explicitly contrast instant pre-made adoption vs photo customization.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How You Want to Adopt", "body": "Pick a ready-to-go companion instantly or build a custom desktop pet from your own photo.", "button_label": "Continue"}}
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Docking Ready Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications on home_intro to confirm when the pet successfully launches into the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Your Desktop Pet is Active!", "body": "Look for your pet on screen or in the system tray to start interacting."}}
9: [adoption, incentive] Friend Selection Badge Highlight: Add highlight badges to pet options on pick_friend screen to guide pet selection.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Popular Companion", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the certificate layout while retaining official adoption details is allowed.
Moving the sign-in step within onboarding while retaining all required steps is permitted.
Adding a controls summary screen within onboarding is permitted.
Adding a style picker sub-flow during custom pet adoption is permitted.
Displaying time estimates and progress for a real wait period is allowed.
Redesigning the story layout while continuing to introduce the pet is allowed.
Adding a profile sync reassurance hint on sign-in is allowed.
Updating choice copy clearly presents both adoption paths without losing function.
Enabling ready notifications on home intro is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a playful popular badge to guidance options is allowed and fair.
